A Very Mythic Christmas Sale: Phase 1 -  Live today at 1PM CST / 19:00 UTC
,
The season has turned mythical across the domes. 
Phase 1 of the Christmas Sale opens today, bringing a wide lineup of items for racers, fighters, builders, and collectors. 
This release includes the first ever X Class racer along with new weapons, cosmetics, and a complete holiday building kit.
Below is the full list of Phase 1 items.

New Marketplace Feature: NOW ACCEPTING CREDIT CARDS
For players who prefer a traditional checkout, the marketplace now accepts credit cards, removing the need to spend crypto unless you choose to.


Shinobi X – First Ever X Class Racer (200 total quantity)
(Limit 5 per address and 3 per order)
A milestone release. The Shinobi X is the first X Class vehicle ever offered for sale. Built around a single seat cockpit and dual high output engines, it is engineered for precision flying, rapid response, and sustained top speed. Designed for pilots who want to win with intent.

Borne + Lee P1 Pulse Rifle (2000 total quantity)
(Limit 100 per address and 10 per order)
A disciplined energy platform tuned for accuracy. Powered by a high density pulse cell that delivers consistent bursts with low recoil. Ideal for lane control, mid range pick offs, and players who value precision over volume.

Old World Provisions Trench 12 Shotgun (2000 total quantity)
(Limit 100 per address and 10 per order)
A pre Calamity steel framed trench gun built for reliability in close quarters. Rugged, simple, and forceful. Designed for corridors, breaches, and scenarios where each pull of the trigger must matter.

Quanty the Snowman Hat (400 total quantity)
(Limit 5 per address and 3 per order)
A full head cosmetic channeling the twisted winter figure from old tales. Frozen grin, burning blue eyes, and a bent top hat that sets the tone the moment you enter a room.

Jingle Jester Hat (400 total quantity)
(Limit 5 per address and 3 per order)
A loud seasonal cosmetic wrapped in red and green with bell lined trim. Built for players who treat the holidays like a competitive sport. Purely cosmetic and unmistakable in any lobby.

Holiday 2025 Themed Building Kit (500 total quantity)
(Limit 5 per address and 3 per order)
A complete decoration pack for players who want their apartment to feel lived in for the season.
Includes:
• Fully lit holiday tree
• Wrapped presents
• Garland and poinsettia arrangements
• Table centerpieces
• Candles and seasonal props
All pieces are modular and freely placeable for simple or fully immersive holiday setups.


Minting Opens Soon
Step into the festivities and mint your items here:
https://link.infinityrising.com/MythicalChristmas

Phase 1 marks the start of a winter season filled with new content and major updates. Thank you for supporting the project and shaping the journey forward. (edited)

Release 0.3.8 — WINTER INVASION IS LIVE
,
A new build has deployed across Infinity Rising, bringing invading drones, new weapons, a new racer manufacturer, and full integration of Christmas Sale items. Full patch notes below.

Combat System Updates
,
Scanner devices now detect drones within range.
Drones are now classified into Light, Medium, and Heavy types:


Light – similar to the original drones
,
Medium – equipped with blasters and improved armor plate placement
,
Heavy – equipped with a random gatlin pulse energy array weapon head and heavily armored across most of their chassis
,

Players are encouraged to bring backup, food, drinks, ammo, and medical supplies when going drone hunting. Heavy drones are extremely dangerous.

---


New Vehicle Manufacturer: Kazekura

Kazekura joins the world with the first X-Class racer, the Shinobi-X, now available at the Calido Valley Raceway.

---


Networking and Performance Improvements
,
Jetpacking network optimizations
,
Avatar networking data improvements
,
Numerous networking issues resolved
,
Minor updates to lighting, color grading, and avatar shading
,

---


KNOWN ISSUES
,
Ghost Drones
,
Some drones may lose their shells and become invisible attackers.


Outfit Clipping
,
Clip morphs are currently disabled, causing certain outfit combinations to clip.


Collision and Performance Issues
,
Some areas may have collision inconsistencies or performance dips.


Needs System (Work in Progress)
,
UI may display duplicates; respawning or restarting resolves this.
,
Does not function in Calido Valley Raceway/Pavilion.
,
Not all food or drink items currently replenish needs.
,

---


DLSS and Nvidia Features
,
These features may significantly enhance performance on some systems but are highly dependent on CPU/GPU bottlenecks, specific graphic settings, and resolution.
Testing and tuning are recommended. Some settings used together may reduce performance.

---


Lighting and Visual Notes
,
Adjusted global lighting and coloring to improve visual clarity.
,
Interiors may appear too bright with Hardware Lumen off; enabling it is recommended if supported.
,
Some lighting and shadow flickering may occur on fog, clouds, or environmental surfaces at certain times of day.
,
Water materials are mid-rework and may show unusual reflection behavior.
,

---


Winter Invasion has begun. Prepare, scan, and take back the Solaces.
,

Marketplace Rotation Roll-out: What to Expect
,
In the near future, Marketplace drops will follow a new cadence designed for flexibility and research. 
Items will be rotated in and out, each with its own individual release timing and announcement strategy. 


When an item goes live, it will be announced on its own—no fixed schedule, no predictable pattern.

To the public, these releases will appear fully randomized, and there will be no stated timing on how long any item will remain in the Marketplace. 


This allows the team to test different approaches behind the scenes, gather cleaner data, and refine how future sales and rotations are handled.

Stay alert, keep an eye on announcements, and be ready—Any item could go live or expire at any time.

Komaru Double Dragon 28 Gauge | Live in the Marketplace

The Komaru Double Dragon 28 Gauge is a compact shotgun pistol built for moments where distance disappears and decisions must be final.

This is not a primary weapon. It is a specialist sidearm for room entries, last second defenses, and when your main weapon runs dry and the threat is already close.

The Messenger Bobblehead brings one of Infinity Rising’s most mysterious figures into your personal space. 
This miniature statue captures the cloaked silhouette and masked presence of the being that first warned the Rifts were only the beginning.
Purely cosmetic and designed as a lore piece, it’s meant for apartments and display areas. 
The subtle idle head bob creates the quiet feeling that the Messenger is always watching.
For players drawn to atmosphere and deeper story threads, the message is waiting.

The Cozy Clause Hat is also now available for those who want holiday style without the armor. 
This plush Santa-style cap pairs rich red fabric with a soft white brim and pom, giving your character a relaxed winter look perfect for social hubs and casual moments. 
No stats. Just vibes.


Like Santa’s sleigh, and the Messenger’s appearances, these items won’t linger forever. 
Marketplace rotation means they can vanish without notice.

@everyone 

We need to address a clear mistake on our side.

In a prior announcement (2022), we communicated that future bobbleheads would follow a 1:1 burn-to-mint path. We recently released another bobblehead and did not provide the promised burn option for holders of the previous one. That is an oversight, and it is on us.

We understand why this matters. A player-driven economy only works when the rules are consistent and the team honors what it puts in writing. 

What we are doing now...

We are building a recovery plan designed to respect the original promise and make affected holders whole.

1) Exclusive Bobblehead 

We will release a new, exclusive bobblehead that is only obtainable through a 1:1 burn-to-mint redemption path.

One burn will equal one mint. No alternate purchase route for this specific item.

2) Redemption window

We will open a dedicated redemption window so existing Joe holders can convert their eligible bobblehead into the exclusive bobblehead under the original 1:1 rule.

3) Public mechanics before launch

Before anything goes live, we will publish the exact mechanics: eligibility rules, item details (supply + rarities), the start and end dates, and the full step-by-step claim flow.
